title: Placement Officer
description:
**Job description:** 




 We are looking for a dedicated and self\-driven Placement Officer to manage job opportunities for fresh technical and non\-technical candidates. This role involves working closely with students and companies to ensure successful placements and career growth.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage the 
 **end\-to\-end recruitment cycle**
* **Screen and shortlist candidate resumes**
* **Identify suitable job openings based on candidate skills and qualifications**
* **Coordinate with companies for placements, internships, and training programs**
* **Follow up with candidates to ensure smooth onboarding**
* **Provide career guidance and placement support to students**
* **Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate partners**
* **Promote placement activities through social media channels**
* **Monitor student joining and manage training activities**



  





 Qualifications
 


* Degree / MBA (HR specialization preferred)
* Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience can apply



  





 Required Skills
 


* Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint,canva,Google Docs, Google Sheets \& Google Slides
* Email Management (Gmail \& Outlook)
* Zoom, Google Meet \& Microsoft Teams
* Basic Computer \& Internet Skills
* Social Media Management
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Excellent convincing and networking ability
* Self\-motivated with a confident attitude
* Flexible and adaptable to work timings
* Passion for placements and student career development



  





 Language Requirements
 


* English: Professional (written \& spoken)
* Malayalam: Communicative

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Medventure Holdings is part of Medventure Group, a dynamic and rapidly expanding conglomerate with operations in 7\+ countries, including the UAE, India, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Uzbekistan, and Georgia. The group focuses on innovation across multiple industries, providing services in education, hospitality, travel, and related sectors. Medventure is driven by a team of young, passionate entrepreneurs committed to continuous growth and delivering excellence. Its mission is to create lasting value for clients through world\-class services and meaningful global connections. The company values expanding horizons, creating opportunities, and maintaining strong standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Thrissur. This role is responsible for leading end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, and retention initiatives. The Human Resources Manager will develop and implement HR policies, ensure compliance with labor laws and company standards, and support organizational change and growth. Day\-to\-day tasks include partnering with business leaders on workforce planning, resolving employee relations issues, managing HR documentation and HRIS data, and coordinating training and development programs. The role also involves driving a positive workplace culture, managing payroll and benefits in coordination with relevant teams, and preparing HR reports and analytics to inform leadership decisions.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong experience in core HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Skills in HR policy development, compliance with labor regulations, and managing HR documentation and HRIS systems.
* Ability to design and support training, development, and employee engagement initiatives to foster a positive work environment.
* Competence in workforce planning, organizational development, and supporting change management in a fast\-growing company.
* Excellent interpersonal, conflict resolution, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and cultures.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, including experience preparing HR metrics, reports, and insights for leadership.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) are an advantage.
* Previous experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in multi\-location or multinational organizations.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Lyka Packaging Pvt. Ltd. is a specialized provider of plastic food containers, serving diverse food packaging needs with high\-quality, durable solutions. The company is supported by a professional team of engineers who collaborate closely with customers to design and deliver effective packaging options. Management emphasizes innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring the organization stays aligned with the latest developments in packaging technology and market trends. With an in\-house moulding facility, best\-in\-class injection moulding machines, and integrated printing and in\-mould labelling (IML) capabilities, Lyka Packaging offers end\-to\-end packaging solutions under one roof.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam. This role is responsible for overseeing the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include partnering with department heads to identify staffing needs, managing HR policies and compliance, and maintaining accurate HR records and documentation. The Human Resources Manager will handle employee relations, support training and development initiatives, and contribute to a positive, inclusive workplace culture. The role also involves monitoring labor law compliance, supporting payroll and benefits coordination with relevant teams, and recommending process improvements to strengthen HR operations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Experience in HR policy development, implementation, and compliance with applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Skills in conflict resolution, coaching, and supporting employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Proficiency in HRIS or HR management software and comfortable working with spreadsheets and documentation tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and levels.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain professional ethics.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in manufacturing or packaging industries.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ernakulam and engaging directly with production, engineering, and management teams.
